secured_base_modules.reason: Modules that define SecuredViewSet / SecuredAPIView themselves (ADR-004); they must subclass DRF bases.

raw_sql.reason: ADR-004 allow-list: RLS policies (iam/rls), the report compiler, migrations; ADR-003 tenancy binding uses SET LOCAL inside kernel.tenancy.bind().

http_clients.reason: Outbound HTTP only inside integration adapters (DIAN, PILA, banks, payments, LLM, e-mail). backend/kernel/io_guard.py (one file, FIX-D-W01-1): the external-I/O guard imports requests/httpx only to wrap Session.request / Client.send so that every outbound call outside an adapter raises; it never performs a request.
